services.title: Study & college admissions
services.short: Find the right course and college.
services.long: Friends is a recruitment agent for Australian colleges. We help you choose a course, apply and get your offer.

services.title: Student visas
services.long: Student visa applications, from your first visa to changing your course or college.

services.title: Skilled regional visas
services.long: Skilled Work Regional (Provisional) visa subclass 491 and Skilled Employer Sponsored Regional (Provisional) subclass 494.

services.title: Skilled Recognised Graduate
services.long: Skilled Recognised Graduate visa (subclass 476) for recent engineering graduates.

services.title: Visitor visas
services.long: Visitor visa applications for relatives and friends coming to Australia.

services.title: Family & medical visas
services.long: Remaining Relative visas and Medical Treatment visas, among other family streams.

faq: Is there a registered migration agent?
Yes. Manish Kumar Arora is a registered migration agent, MARN 1678522. You can check it on the official OMARA register.
Can you help me get into a college?
Yes. Friends is a recruitment agent for Australian colleges and helps with course choice, applications and student visas.
